description: Text before the first section is a part without a name (as cooklang-rs keeps it: an unnamed section); a = line without a name starts another unnamed part; a section with nothing in it is left out

inputs.text:
> A family recipe.

Heat the oven.

= Empty

= Dough

Mix @flour{200%g} and @water{100%ml}.

=

Serve warm.

source: Synthetic example in the specification's syntax (README, Sections: the section name is optional). The spec says nothing of text before the first section; cooklang-rs (src/model.rs, Recipe.sections, read 2026-11-23) keeps it as a section without a name.
